paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Epoch and Loss for three different member sets. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.0 to 4.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A blue solid line, designated “Regular members”, begins at approximately 3.2 at an Epoch of 0.0 and decreases to approximately 2.8 at an Epoch of 3.0. An orange solid line, designated “Members with near-duplicates”, begins at approximately 3.2 at an Epoch of 0.0 and decreases sharply to approximately 2.1 at an Epoch of 0.5, then remains relatively constant at approximately 2.1 until an Epoch of 3.0. A green solid line, designated “Held-out data”, begins at approximately 3.3 at an Epoch of 0.0 and increases slightly to approximately 3.5 at an Epoch of 3.0.
